description: Call this when a user wants to give feedback, report a problem, or suggest an improvement about the Learnosity MCP server or its documentation. Returns a friendly message and a link to the Learnosity MCP Feedback Page to share with the user. This does not collect feedback in the chat. Do not ask the user for their email, credentials, ratings, or any structured feedback fields in the chat - the linked page collects everything.
name: get_feedback_link
title: Get the Learnosity MCP Feedback Link
